title: Assessment of Sleep Dynamics in a Simulated Space Station Environment
archive_status: Data preservation is complete. All datasets are publicly available.
notes: Downloaded: tabular files (xls/xlsx/csv/txt) and PDF reports up to 50 MB. Every Excel sheet is also saved as '<file>__<sheet>.csv' (raw cell grid, no header detection).
Not downloaded: figure images (tif/jpg) - they are rendered graphs; their URLs are listed under skipped_files.
Downloaded files are untrusted data: parse only, never open macros / execute.
Ground analog (Lunar-Mars Life Support Test Project, chamber Phase II 30 d and Phase III 91 d, 4 crew each = 8 subjects).
Only group means ± SEM (n=8) of sleep variables; no per-subject data. Melatonin/light/rhythm results only as graph images (TIF, not downloaded).
Not importable to observation; usable as cohort reference values for sleep.

files/JMGROUNDLMLSTP34_115/JMGROUNDLMLST.what: Sleep variables in chamber crewmembers: objective (Actillume actigraphy) and subjective (AIRLOG sleep log), baseline vs chamber

rows.name: WASO (wake after sleep onset)
rows.unit: h (not stated; same scale as latency)

pitfalls: Sheet is named 'Integration Standards' (template name), not a data label.

files/JMGROUNDLMLSTP34_1/JMGROUNDLMLSTP3.what: Data collection timetables (one sheet per session type: Actillume 48 h, AIRLOG sleep log, saliva melatonin every 2 h, void-by-void urine). Schedule only: Phase II/III pre-/in-/post-chamber, dates 'not available'.

files.dataset_description: This spreadsheet represents the data collection timetables for data collection sessions for this experiment.  Information in this spreadsheet may include information on the test protocol, data collection constraints, parameters measured, hardware used, sheduled versus actual days of data collection and subject information.
